# TASTE The Show

> TASTE The Show is a Las Vegas pole, burlesque, contortion and variety show created and produced by Fawnia Mondey. It returns in 2027 with three Wednesday-night shows at Gipsy Nightclub, 4605 Paradise Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89169. Doors 7:00 PM, show 8:00 PM to about 9:30 PM. Tickets are sold by Gipsy Nightclub (coming soon).

- Creator and producer: Fawnia Mondey, world-renowned pole icon and owner of Pole Fitness Studio, Las Vegas' legendary pole & aerial studio.
- The show: sensual pole, sizzling burlesque, contortion & acrobatics, and dance & live variety.
- 2027 dates (all Wednesdays): January 20, 2027; May 19, 2027; September 15, 2027.
- Ticket tiers per show: General Admission (open seating), VIP (premium seats by the stage), Table (reserved for your group). Ticket sales are coming soon via Gipsy Nightclub.
- Bring cash for tipping the performers; change is available.
- Instagram: @tastetheshow (https://www.instagram.com/tastetheshow/) — new dates are announced there first.

## Friends of TASTE

- [The Melissa Foundation](https://themelissafoundation.org): a 501(c)(3) empowering people with knowledge, resources and support to make healthier choices before, during and after cancer
- [Pole Fitness Studio](https://polefitnessstudio.com): Las Vegas' legendary pole & aerial studio — classes, bachelorette parties and instructor certification
- [Pole Fitness Online](https://www.polefitnessonline.com): live-streamed and on-demand pole classes from Pole Fitness Studio
- [Officially Fawnia](https://officiallyfawnia.com): Fawnia Mondey, the pole dance pioneer and fitness model who created TASTE
- [Burlesque To Go](https://burlesquetogo.com): burlesque dancers for parties, events and suites in Las Vegas
- [Bachelorette Pole Dancing Parties](https://www.bachelorettepoledancingparties.com): private Las Vegas bachelorette pole dancing parties
- [Las Vegas Pole Rentals](https://lasvegaspolerentals.com): portable professional dance poles and stages, delivered and set up
- [I Love Pole Because](https://ilovepolebecause.com): real stories from the pole community
